query:
-- Check product images for both campaigns
SELECT 
  c.searchId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_companies,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pi.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.id END) AS companies_with_product_images,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pi.id IS NULL THEN c.id END) AS companies_missing_product_images
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON pi.companyId = c.id
WHERE c.searchId IN (1500003, 1350004)
GROUP BY c.searchId;
